headline: How ICE’s Resilient Early-Stage Mortgage Trends Have Changed Its Investment Story
summary: In June 2026, Intercontinental Exchange, Inc. reported its ICE First Look mortgage trends showing early-stage delinquencies remained low and new default activity declined, with FHA defaults recording their largest annual drop in more than four years. Although foreclosure starts reached a six-year high, they still remained below pre-pandemic levels, highlighting a mortgage market where underlying credit quality appears resilient even as later-stage stress slowly builds.
